description: The bar chart, titled "The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets," illustrates the number of datasets published each year from 2013 to 2022, categorized by whether they targeted specific groups (Targeted, shown in orange) or did not (Untargeted, shown in blue). The horizontal x-axis represents the year, with labels from 2013 to 2022, while the vertical y-axis, labeled "Number of datasets," ranges from 0 to 160 with major gridlines at intervals of 20. The data reveals a significant increase in the total number of datasets over the decade. In the early years (2013-2015), the number of datasets was very low, with only a few untargeted ones. A notable shift occurred around 2016, when the number of targeted datasets began to rise sharply, surpassing the number of untargeted datasets by 2018. This trend continued, with the total number of datasets peaking in 2020 at over 160, of which approximately 120 were targeted and 40 were untargeted. The chart visually emphasizes the growing focus on targeted hateful communication in research, as the orange bars (Targeted) become the dominant component in the stacked bars from 2018 onwards.
